slides.headline: TESLA'S CYBERCABS ARE EVERYWHERE IN DOWNTOWN AUSTIN WITH NO STEERING WHEEL AND NO PEDALS, NOBODY IS DRIVING THEM.
MOST PEOPLE THOUGHT THIS WAS STILL YEARS AWAY
slides.body:
Picture yourself walking through downtown Austin at midnight.

Not one Cybercab. Dozens. Rolling through city streets completely on their own.

And then you looked inside one.

slides.headline: CYBERCABS WERE EVERYWHERE. NOBODY INSIDE ANY OF THEM.
slides.body: 2.8 million people saw the clips by morning. Sawyer Merritt walked Austin streets at 12:29 AM, filming every one he passed. Nobody thought to look for what else was gone.

slides.headline: ZERO STEERING WHEELS. ZERO PEDALS.
slides.body: No human can physically take over. So what happens next?

slides.headline: THE UBER DRIVER ERA JUST GOT AN EXPIRATION DATE
slides.body:
These aren't the kind with a backup driver.

They are physically built without any controls a human would need.

Your Uber driver can't compete with a car that never clocks out.

slides.headline: AUTONOMOUS PICKUPS MEAN ZERO DRIVER PAYROLL
slides.body: You're still paying a driver to pick up your customers. Cybercabs have no driver costs and run 24/7. The businesses that switch first will own this before you notice.

caption:
Tesla Cybercabs with zero steering wheels and zero pedals are already driving themselves through downtown Austin. Swipe to see what that actually means 🤖

Midnight Austin streets flooded with driverless Cybercabs, zero steering wheels and zero pedals confirmed on every car in the footage, no human takeover possible even in an emergency, 2.8 million views in one night, what fully autonomous taxis mean for drivers, and why the businesses that move first will own this customer experience before anyone else does.

This is not a pilot program. Fully autonomous vehicles with no human override are already navigating major American city streets at midnight. The question is not whether robot taxis are coming. They are here.
